root_cause.poll-held-close-startup-sweep: Held closes / announcements were applied only by settleHeldCloses, called from handlers of a later message of the same poll. The journal replay covers a close or summary whose own handling threw, but not held state whose triggering rumor was acked: a held summary whose replay failed inside settleHeldCloses, recoverHeldCloses failures on the closed-poll vote and duplicate-open paths, a pre-open hold whose open-time settle failed after the open was acked on a later replay, and poison-dropped rumors.
root_cause.poll-kept-votes-held-close-aware-pruning: keptVotes sliced to the last MAX_VOTES_KEPT_PER_VOTER by receipt without knowing the held closes' receipt times, so the vote a held close needed could be the one dropped.
root_cause.poll-superseded-prune-at-close: savePoll only rewrote the poll list; vote rows kept superseded snapshots no reader uses once the poll is closed.
root_cause.poll-receipt-clock-seed-failure-backward: seedReceiptClock read the persisted mark once; on failure the receipt was Date.now()-based and could fall below the previous session's mark after a backward clock step.
root_cause.pending-vote-cap-drop-observable: queuePendingVote resolved void both when it stored and when the per-voter poll cap dropped the vote.

fix.sweep: DispatcherSubscription.enqueueMaintenance(task) runs a task on the handler FIFO (skipped after disposal, throw warned, never rejects). pollHandler.createHeldPollStateSweeper lists poll ids with held state (pollPersistence.listHeldPollIds: early votes, closes, announcements) and runs recoverStoredPoll (factored out of handleOpen's existing-poll branch) for each stored poll; unstored polls are left for their open. buildDispatcher returns BuiltDispatcher.sweepHeldPollState; MarmotContext enqueues it after the journal replay at every (re)subscription.
fix.pruning: keptVotes(votes, cutoffs) = undominated + capKept: the newest and voteAsOf(cut-off) for each cut-off are always kept, remaining room to the latest-received others. Vote writes (saveVoteIfNewer, queuePendingVote) read the poll's held closes inside their queue slot only when the cap bites; a failed read falls back to the plain cap (warned). saveVoteIfNewer compares against the stored set unpruned so an above-cap set is not re-pruned by a re-delivery.
fix.close_prune: savePoll of a closed poll then drops superseded from the poll's vote rows on the votes key queue (no write if none); failure warned, closed poll stays stored.
fix.seed_retry: seedReceiptClock retries the read up to RECEIPT_SEED_ATTEMPTS=3 with 25/50 ms backoff before handing out the receipt; on exhaustion the receipt is handed out anyway and the next one re-seeds. Second floor source not built (same IDB failure domain, full key scan cost).
fix.cap_drop_signal: queuePendingVote: Promise<boolean> — true when stored or represented by a dominating kept entry, false when the per-voter cap (or the group cap, for an explicitly earlier receipt) evicted it; a failed write rejects. handleVote's save-failure fallback warns with group/poll/voter/rumor id on false and rethrows the save error.

remediation_round_1.trigger: Codex: HIGH sweep not cancellable / purge undone; MEDIUM overlapping sweeps overwrite a closed result; MEDIUM vote-only recovery not shown

fixes.cancellation: enqueueMaintenance passes isDisposed(); sweepHeldPollState(ctx, isCancelled) guards every dep (guardDeps: check before each call and after each awaited result, throws MaintenanceCancelled); the held-summary replay is built per run from guarded chat deps and a settler over guarded poll deps.
fixes.purge_guard: pollTxn: one readwrite transaction on the default keyval store via the store callback + promisifyRequest(os.transaction), never update(). Closed savePoll re-reads the poll in-txn: absent -> no write (null), already closed -> no overwrite (returns stored). Close-time prune is one txn. saveVoteIfNewer(vote, {requirePoll}) reads poll list + rows (+ held closes when needed, read error handled with preventDefault) and writes nothing when the poll is gone; every early-vote replay passes requirePoll.
fixes.first_close_wins: Closing monotonic and idempotent at storage; storeClosed returns the stored close (summary gate announces what the card shows); a null result -> 'unknown', no further writes. PollStoreContext shows the stored result.
fixes.ui_refresh: replayPendingVotes returns the count stored; recoverStoredPoll bumps pollVersion on stored votes or a close; persistence posts postStoreChanged('polls') after commit when it wrote.

residuals: A held summary's chat-row append can still land in the window between the gate's poll read and the append if a leave purges without disposing first (chat rows are outside the poll store; guarded by cancellation once disposed).
The summary gate's hold for a just-purged poll re-creates a held announcement entry (expires after 7 days, never applied).

fixes.single_txn_purge: clearPollData = one readwrite pollTxn (PollTxn.delete + allKeys via os.getAllKeys): delete polls key, enumerate in-txn, delete the group's vote keys, then pending votes/closes/announcements and seq reservations; settleVotesMigration first. Serialises with every requirePoll vote txn (before: committed then scanned+deleted; after: no poll list, no write).
fixes.partial_replay_bump: replayPendingVotes(poll, deps, progress?) counts stored votes as they land; recoverPendingVotes returns progress.stored after a throw (warned with the count), so recoverStoredPoll bumps once. loadVotesWithPending still rejects; entries stay queued; handleVote unchanged.
fixes.prune_retry: savePoll runs dropSupersededVotes whenever the closed txn resolves a stored poll (also when an earlier close won); postStoreChanged only when written; no prune for a missing poll.
